title: RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.21177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps,

translated_title: RAGE：面向基于流图像编辑的残差自适应门控
translated_abstract: 近期无需反演的基于流的图像编辑方法通过微分速度场将源图像向目标图像演化。我们观察到，该速度场并未显式考虑哪些区域应当被保留，导致非编辑区域出现意外的漂移。为解决这一问题，我们将源保真度控制形式化为一个随机最优控制问题，在编辑轨迹上对编辑残差施加选择性保真项。求解该问题并对其解进行近似，得到了残差门控原理：每个潜在分量以一个随局部残差幅值指数衰减的增益被拉回源图像，从而抑制微小偏差，同时使大的、具有语义意义的编辑畅通无阻地通过。所提出的 RAGE 方法在每个采样步骤中仅需一次轻量级的门控插值，无需掩码估计和注意力图。
tldr: 该论文提出 RAGE 方法，将源保真度控制建模为随机最优控制问题并推导出残差门控原理——以随局部残差幅值指数衰减的增益将潜变量拉回源图像，从而无需掩码或注意力图即可抑制非编辑区域的意外漂移，同时保留有语义意义的编辑。
en_tdlr: RAGE formulates source-fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem and derives a Residual Gating Principle that pulls latent components back toward the source with a gain decaying exponentially with residual magnitude, suppressing unintended drift in non-editing regions without masks or attention maps while preserving semantically meaningful edits.
